string.name: dictate__setup_mic_a11y
string.comment: Screen reader name of the greyed-out mic before a voice model is downloaded

string.name: dictate__setup_title
string.comment: Title of the keyboard sheet that picks a voice model to download

string.name: dictate__setup_intro
string.comment: Intro text of the voice model picker

resources.string: Pick a voice model to download once. After that, dictation works offline and your voice stays on your phone. Wi-Fi is best.

string.name: dictate__setup_speed
string.comment: Bar graph label: how fast the model turns speech into text

string.name: dictate__setup_accuracy
string.comment: Bar graph label: how few mistakes the model makes

string.name: dictate__setup_size
string.comment: Bar graph label: how much storage the model takes

string.name: dictate__setup_size_mb
string.comment: Download size of a model. {mb} is a whole number of megabytes.

string.name: dictate__setup_recommended
string.comment: Badge on the recommended model

string.name: dictate__setup_blurb_tiny
string.comment: Very short description of Whisper Tiny

string.name: dictate__setup_blurb_base
string.comment: Very short description of Whisper Base

string.name: dictate__setup_blurb_small
string.comment: Very short description of Whisper Small

string.name: dictate__setup_action_download
string.comment: Status on a model card that has not been downloaded

string.name: dictate__setup_action_retry
string.comment: Status on a model card whose download failed

string.name: dictate__setup_action_use
string.comment: Status on a model card that is already downloaded but not in use

string.name: dictate__setup_level_a11y
string.comment: Screen reader text for one bar graph. {label} is Speed or Accuracy, {level} and {max} are numbers.

string.name: dictate__setup_action_cancel
string.comment: Status on the card of the model being downloaded; tapping cancels

string.name: dictate__setup_downloading
string.comment: Progress on a model card. {percent} is 0-100.

string.name: dictate__setup_busy
string.comment: Status on the other cards while one model downloads

string.name: dictate__setup_background_hint
string.comment: Shown under the cards while a model downloads

resources.string: The download keeps going if you close this. Dictation turns on by itself when it finishes.

string.name: dictate__setup_failed_network
string.comment: A model download failed because there is no connection

resources.string: No connection. Connect to Wi-Fi or mobile data, then tap the model to try again.

string.name: dictate__setup_failed_storage
string.comment: A model download failed because the phone is full

resources.string: Your phone ran out of space. Free some up, then tap the model to try again.

string.name: dictate__setup_failed_other
string.comment: A model download failed for another reason

resources.string: The download didn’t finish. Tap the model to try again.

string.name: dictate__setup_no_room
string.comment: Shown instead of starting a download the phone has no room for. {model} is the model name, {needed} and {free} are whole megabytes.

resources.string: {model} needs {needed} MB free, and your phone has {free} MB. Free some space, or pick a smaller model.

string.name: dictate__setup_ready_toast
string.comment: Toast when a model finished downloading from the keyboard. {model} is the model name.

resources.string: {model} is ready. Tap the mic to dictate, even offline.

string.name: dictate__setup_use_cloud
string.comment: Link under the model picker for people who would rather use a cloud service with their own API key

resources.string: Have an API key? Use a cloud service instead
